- Published
An appeals court in Iran has confirmed a sentence of 74 lashes handed to a prominent singer who performed without the mandatory hijab, lawyers say.
Parastoo Ahmadi sang while wearing a sleeveless dress during a concert livestreamed on her YouTube channel in December 2024, external.
Iran's laws ban public performances by women and require them to wear headscarves and modest clothing.

The skulls and bones of at least 28 people have been recovered from suspected criminal camps in Nigerian forests.

Police in the south-eastern state of Abia are investigating the identities of the remains found in the Umuaku and Nneato forests on Saturday after a security operation was carried out in the Umunneochi area.
Police spokeswoman Maureen Chinaka said the suspects fled when police arrived.

articles.title_zh: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
facts_zh:
Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
- Published
South Korea has summoned Ukraine's acting ambassador after President Volodymyr Zelensky last week announced his government had transferred two captured North Korean soldiers to Seoul.
Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo lodged a formal complaint with Andrii Vieshkin and expressed "strong regret" that Zelensky had revealed the transfer, which Seoul says was supposed to be a secret.
The two North Koreans, who were among thousands of soldiers supporting Russia in the Ukraine war, had earlier told local media they wanted to be sent to South Korea.

articles.title_original: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
articles.title_zh: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
facts_zh:
Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
- Published
People living on the northern Pacific coast of Mexico are bracing for the arrival of Hurricane Polo, which is forecast to make landfall later on Monday or early on Tuesday.

The category three storm, with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph (185 km/h), is expected to move over the state of Baja California Sur, a region popular with tourists and home to the resort destination of Los Cabos.
Meteorologists at the US-based National Hurricane Center (NHC) have warned of heavy rainfall which could lead to life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain.

all_titles.en: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo

articles.title_original: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction
articles.title_zh: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction
facts_zh: Capital city submerged in waist-high flood water, while elsewhere Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii’s Big Island Bangkok was declared a disaster zone by its city officials towards the end of last week, after streets in Thailand’s capital city were submerged in up to waist-high flood water.
The flooding stemmed from an active cell of low pressure across central Thailand that brought continuous heavy rainfall and thunderstorms to Bangkok and surrounding regions.
The heavy rain began early on Thursday when the weak area of low pressure travelled north-westwards up the gulf of Thailand before then sitting over central Thailand by Friday morning.

all_titles.en: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction

articles.title_zh: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
facts_zh:
Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
- Published
On Monday, China released more information of what was agreed at the talks between Xi Jinping and Donald Tump last week, shedding light on a handful of concrete outcomes.
But there were no joint statements and few major breakthroughs.
Instead, both governments issued separate accounts of the meeting - perhaps a sign that despite the White House tours and promise of warmer ties, Washington and Beijing remain wary of each other.
